title: Sketch of propeller/S-shaped object with protruding round cups, 6–8 ft long
description: Rotated page with a hand-drawn outline of a two-lobed, propeller- or S-shaped object covered with small circles, annotated "These are round cups which protrude". Dimension lines read "6' to 8'" (length) and "1-1/2' x 2'". The sketch carries a typed signature block of a USAF 1st Lt. intelligence officer and struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps.
